notes.title: v1.5.0-beta
notes.content: [list][*][p]Deck building has been completely renewed! It has been changed to a system where you add 5–15 cards of your choice to a base set of 20 cards.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][list][*][p]The sixth hero has been introduced.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][list][*][p]The deck of the first Space hero has been completely revamped; its disruptive (opponent-interfering) concept has been strengthened.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][list][*][p]Balance adjustments were applied to 5 cards.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][list][*][p]Fixed a bug where effects did not work correctly when discarding cards.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: v1.4.0-beta
notes.content: [list][*][p]A balance patch has been applied to 27 cards.[/p][/*][*][p]The UI has been improved to show chapter progress.[/p][/*][*][p]Each hero now appears at the start of combat to enhance visibility.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: v1.2.0-beta
notes.content:
1. Names have been added to all cards. Now each card can be clearly distinguished.


2. Bugs have been fixed:
- The hero illustration for the underground region not displaying
- The starting card for the underground region's hero not appearing

notes.title: v1.1.0-beta
notes.content:
1. A new region, the Underground, has been added. 24 new underground cards have been added, along with 9 related cards.


2. A new hero has been added. They explore the Underground, Ocean, and Ice regions, and must use various volatile cards according to the situation.


3. Bugs have been fixed:
- Volume control did not apply until the settings window was opened after starting the game
- The screen was displayed abnormally when clicking the continue button multiple times on the main screen
